remarks: A great opportunity to own or invest in a condo in Stamford. Spacious, Quiet, Rear, Corner Unit, Beautiful, Open floorplan, 1Br, 1.5 bath Condo with a Stunning Sunset Views. Marble Kitchen Counter Top and new Steel Appliances. Huge, Living room with Balcony offer spectacular city views. Large master suite with updated marble bathrooms. Located in sought after Concierge building with Gym, Pool, Sauna, Storage, Party Room and ease of same-floor laundry and trash facilities. Condo fees include Heat, Hot Water, Cooking Gas, Pest Control, Gym with Sauna, Party room, Pool, Storage and Front Desk Receptionist. Walk to Mill River, Parks and Recreation Sites, Restaurants, Beaches, Library and Shopping Mall, Theaters and entertainment. Close to I95, and Metro North train station also On the bus line. Walk to free Trolly going to harbor point, downtown. Its a perfect blend of Convenience, Comfort and Coastal charm.
